name: Allianz Travel Insurance

price.headline: From 4% to 8% of trip cost
price.note: Price depends on coverage level, trip cost, traveler age, and destination. Older travelers pay more.

key_facts.label: Trip cancellation
key_facts.value: Up to 100% of trip cost for covered reasons

key_facts.label: Medical coverage
key_facts.value: Up to $50,000 (OneTrip Prime); higher on premium plans

key_facts.label: Pre-existing conditions
key_facts.value: Covered if purchased within 14 days of first trip deposit

pros: Pre-existing condition waiver available if purchased early
Wide range of plans from basic to comprehensive
cons: Premiums increase significantly for travelers over 70
Cancel-for-any-reason costs extra and reimburses only 75%
Claims process can take several weeks
best_for: travelers booking expensive trips who want protection against cancellation and medical emergencies
skip_if: your credit card already provides sufficient trip cancellation and medical coverage for your trip
rating_reason: A reliable, established provider. Coverage is solid for standard needs. Price for older travelers can be steep. Worth comparing quotes for any specific trip.
